name: Stone Ridge Engineering, LLC
what_they_do: Consulting engineering firm providing mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire-protection (MEP/FP) design plus due diligence reports, feasibility studies, peer reviews and design/build project management. Also holds a NJ electrical contractor licence, bridging design and installation.
customers: Architects, building owners, tenants, developers and real estate brokers; sectors include pharmaceutical, retail, higher education, data centers, science and technology.

size_signals.signal: Robert Cioffi named as President and Senior Electrical Engineer; describes a 'fully licensed staff' without giving headcount (inference: small, principal-led firm)
Client/project logos on the about page (Munich RE, Advaxis, Sabert, National Business Parks, Freshii)
Single office at 1583 Livingston Ave, Suite 4, North Brunswick

listing.reviews: No review count shown on the Maps panel

website_review.primary_cta: 'Contact us today' text link low on the page; no button above the fold
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Simple contact form (name, address, phone, email, comments); no quote or scheduling flow
website_review.trust_signals: Client logos, PE and licensed electrical contractor credentials, service-specific pages, 12+ years experience cited
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Hand-coded static site with no copyright line; a broken/empty image placeholder renders on the contact page
website_review.search_basics: Titles are page names only ('Home | StoneRidge Engineering, LLC.'); no meta description; no town or service in titles; however MEP Engineering, Due Diligence and Feasibility Studies each have their own page
top_issues: Google Business Profile is unclaimed — Maps shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours' and 'Add photos'
No meta descriptions and no LocalBusiness JSON-LD; titles omit service and town
Phone number is plain text, not a tel: link, on desktop and mobile
Broken image placeholder on the contact page and no CTA button above the fold

agent_readiness.notes: Google Maps shows an unclaimed listing ('Claim this business', 'Add hours', no photos, no review count). robots.txt returns a 404, so nothing is blocked — Googlebot, OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are all permitted by default. Zero JSON-LD. Services and the address are real text; business hours are missing entirely. Contact form fields are labelled, but there is no agent-followable path after submit.

operations_signals.signal: Enquiries funnel into a 5-field comments form promising 'a representative will be in contact' — manual triage and follow-up (inference)
Only one principal engineer named, with staff; proposal and due-diligence report writing likely sits with him (inference from the about page)

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim and complete the Google Business Profile: hours, services, photos and a review-request loop
top_opportunities.evidence: Google Maps panel shows 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', 'Add photos' for Stoneridge Engineering, LLC

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add ProfessionalService/LocalBusiness JSON-LD plus titles and meta descriptions naming MEP engineering and North Brunswick; make the phone number click-to-call
top_opportunities.evidence: Zero JSON-LD blocks, empty meta description, titles are page names only, no tel: links

top_opportunities.opportunity: Qualifying intake agent for RFPs and due-diligence requests that captures building type, square footage, scope and deadline before it reaches the principal
top_opportunities.evidence: Only intake is a free-text comments form, while the site markets due diligence and feasibility studies where scope varies widely

scores.reasons: Gap: unclaimed GBP, no schema, no meta descriptions, no click-to-call, broken image on contact page. Ability: single-principal firm, but commercial MEP fees are high-ticket. Ease: GBP claim plus on-page markup and titles is days of effort. Evidence: live site, contact page and Google Maps panel all inspected.

wrong_claims.claim: contact form works / 'Simple contact form (name, address, phone, email, comments)' as the live intake path
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The five fields and Submit button are present but the form is inert: jQuery core is loaded over plain http://code.jquery.com/jquery-1.11.3.js on an https page, the request is blocked (responseStatus 0), and typeof jQuery is undefined - so jquery.validate, jquery.form.js and the $.ajax handler that posts to contact-submit.php never initialise. Submitting does nothing.

Body text is readable at 390px, but the hamburger menu does nothing (jquery.mmenu depends on the same blocked jQuery), so mobile visitors cannot navigate past the home page; the 390px home page also has a large blank band under the tagline.

wrong_claims.claim: A 'broken/empty image placeholder' renders on the contact page
wrong_claims.what_is_true: No broken image element exists - both images (logo, footer logo) load. What is there is roughly 550px of empty white space where hero content would sit, above the contact heading.
